nodes.label: AI Steerability 360: A Toolkit for Steering Large Language Models
nodes.author: Erik Miehling, Karthikeyan Natesan Ramamurthy, Praveen Venkateswaran, Irene Ko, Pierre Dognin, Moninder Singh, Tejaswini Pedapati, Avinash Balakrishnan, Matthew Riemer, Dennis Wei, Inge Vejsbjerg, Elizabeth M. Daly, Kush R. Varshney
nodes.rationale: Presents unified toolkit for LLM steering across four control surfaces (input, structural, state, output). Enables composition of steering methods and systematic evaluation of steering trade-offs.

nodes.label: Steering Pipeline Abstraction
nodes.rationale: Unified interface for composing multiple steering methods across different control surfaces. Enables systematic study of steering interactions and trade-offs.

nodes.label: State Control Abstractions
nodes.rationale: Reusable patterns for activation steering: estimator (learns steering artifact), selector (chooses control site), transform (applies modification), gate (per-step decision). Enables systematic composition of steering methods.

nodes.label: UseCase and Benchmark Classes
nodes.rationale: Framework for defining tasks and systematically comparing steering pipelines. Enables fixed and variable control parameter evaluation with custom metrics.

nodes.label: ControlSpec Abstraction
nodes.rationale: Enables parameter sweeping for steering methods. Supports Cartesian grids and functional relationships for exploring control parameter space.

nodes.label: Composite Steering
nodes.rationale: Composition of multiple steering methods from different control surfaces. Enables study of complementary vs. conflicting interactions and composition order effects.

nodes.label: PASTA (Post-hoc Attention Steering)
nodes.rationale: State-based control that selectively rescales attention scores at attention heads. Downweights tokens outside input spans to steer model focus toward emphasized tokens.

nodes.label: CAA (Contrastive Activation Addition)
nodes.rationale: State control using paired contrastive examples to compute steering vectors. Adds vectors to hidden states to shift representations toward or away from targeted behavior.

nodes.label: ITI (Inference-Time Intervention)
nodes.rationale: State control using probe-based head selection. Trains per-head probes across all layer-head pairs and steers selected heads to elicit truthful answers.

nodes.label: DeAL (Decoding-time Alignment)
nodes.rationale: Output control implementing reward-guided search during decoding. Enables composition with state controls for improved truthfulness-informativeness tradeoffs.
